expression_restriction.value: Neutral – NO SMILING AND SHOWING OF TEETH.

glasses_policy.value: Tinted glasses are not allowed (photo must be taken without tinted glasses).

face_visibility.value: 2 photos taken from head to shoulders only, showing the full face.

expression.en: Neutral expression - no smiling and no showing of teeth.
expression.ko: 무표정 유지 — 미소 금지, 치아 노출 금지.
expression.ja: 無表情を維持——微笑み禁止、歯を見せることも禁止。

glasses.ja: 色付き眼鏡(サングラス)の着用不可。

face_visibility.en: Photo taken from head to shoulders only, showing the full face.
face_visibility.ko: 머리부터 어깨까지만 촬영, 얼굴 전체가 나오도록 할 것.
face_visibility.ja: 頭から肩までのみを撮影し、顔全体が写るようにすること。

cross_verification.note_en: Official ICA (Immigration and Citizenship Authority) PNG passport checklist confirms photo size as 45mm(H) x 35mm(W), which numerically matches the DB's '3.5 x 4.5cm'. 2 photos required per application. No official PNG source with an explicit head-height figure, photo validity period, or headwear policy was found during this research.
